title: Voidborn Neural Soma: bought at The Core for 258 cr, sold at The Experiment Research Station for 690 cr
note: Written by routemaker.py 2026-11-15 23:12 UTC from two order books: Central Nexus asked 258 cr (deep), The Experiment bid 690 cr for 2 units (22:58 UTC read); 3 units cost about 774 cr. Soma bids of 646 to 690 cr for 1 or 2 units came and went at four of our stations from 21:35 to 22:58 UTC (ledger.py prices voidborn_neural_soma). An estimate, not a measurement. Test of turn T7 (Mercury): one ship; the buy and the sale carry price limits.
